_meta.description: RFE/RL Morning Briefing Tool — Editorial Context File
_meta.instructions: Update this file weekly, ideally on Monday morning before the editorial meeting. It takes effect immediately for all users — no code changes needed. Commit and push to GitHub to deploy.

fields.updatedBy: Name of person who updated it
fields.editorialContext.global: Organisation-wide editorial priorities this week — injected into every role's briefing
fields.editorialContext.byRole: Role-specific additions — use role keys: journalist, editor, service_director, regional_manager, eic, strategist, digital_product, multimedia_producer
fields.sources.add: New sources to include this week — name, url, type (independent/wire/official/semi-official), note, and optionally roles array to limit scope
fields.sources.remove: Sources to suppress this week — name and reason
fields.sources.elevate: Sources to weight higher than usual — name and note

global: RFE/RL editorial priority this week: Iranian nuclear file — any movement on enrichment caps or US-Iran back-channel talks is high priority across all services
Standing watch: Central Asia water rights dispute — cross-service story with potential for escalation
Monitoring: Georgian parliamentary situation — elevated for Caucasus and regional services

journalist: Wire priority: AFP Kabul and Tehran desks are active — check for new wire alerts before filing
editor: Coverage balance check: ensure Iran nuclear file has both breaking and analysis angles in the pipeline
service_director: Audience note: Persian and Dari services seeing elevated traffic on Iran nuclear file — consider additional social pushes
regional_manager: Regional alert: monitor CPJ for any journalist safety developments in Central Asia this week
eic: Editorial position: Iran nuclear file may require unified cross-service direction by end of week
strategist: Benchmark this week: compare Persian service engagement on nuclear file vs Al-Jazeera Arabic and BBC Persian
digital_product: Copilot pilot feedback due this week from Radio Farda and Ukrainian Service — collect and compile
multimedia_producer: Video opportunity: Iran nuclear talks — explainer format performing well in Persian service this month

add.name: Amu TV
add.note: Afghan exile outlet based in Prague — reliable on Afghanistan and Taliban media policy. Add to journalist and regional manager scans.

add.name: Caucasus Watch
add.note: Strong on South Caucasus security and political dynamics. Add to regional manager and service director scans.

remove.name: Khaama Press
remove.reason: Reliability concerns flagged by Kabul bureau — suspend citations until reviewed. Use TOLOnews or Pajhwok as alternatives for Afghanistan coverage.

elevate.name: Iran International
elevate.note: Elevated to Tier 1 this week — major sourcing activity on nuclear file. Prioritise over other Persian-language sources for Iran coverage.
